comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Portal already mounts on document.body; the sticky bar still paints over it. Will bump toast layer and add a regression snapshot at sticky=true.

content.text: Portal already mounts on document.body; the sticky bar still paints over it. Will bump toast layer and add a regression snapshot at sticky=true.

When the sticky editor toolbar is pinned (scrollY > 64), success and error toasts from save, share, and permission actions render underneath the toolbar instead of above it. Clicks on toast actions never register because the toolbar captures pointer events.
Toasts should sit in a layer above chrome UI. Currently toast z-index is 40 while the sticky toolbar uses 50, so any toast that appears near the top of the viewport is fully or partially obscured.

Stacking context is created by the toolbar's position: sticky plus transform used for the shadow fade. Raising the toast portal to z-index 60 (or moving it outside the editor stacking root) should fix it. Missed confirmations are especially painful on failed share invites where the error is invisible.

Stacking context is created by the toolbar's position: sticky plus transform used for the shadow fade. Raising the toast portal to z-index 60 (or moving it outside the editor stacking root) should fix it. Missed confirmations are especially painful on failed share invites where the error is invisible.
